WITH
  TeamWins AS (
    SELECT
      season_id,
      team_name_home AS team_name,
      COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM game
    WHERE
      wl_home = 'W' AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
    GROUP BY
      season_id,
      team_name_home
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      season_id,
      team_name_away AS team_name,
      COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM game
    WHERE
      wl_away = 'W' AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
    GROUP BY
      season_id,
      team_name_away
  )
SELECT
  team_name,
  SUM(wins) AS total_wins_in_season
FROM TeamWins
GROUP BY
  season_id,
  team_name
ORDER BY
  total_wins_in_season DESC
LIMIT 1;
